select * from BUSC.DELTA_REF_TBL where delta_status = 'DELTA' and source_code = 'TRU'

TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.TRU_BASELINK_DELTA; WITH SRC AS ( SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CUST_NO,CIF_NO,BR_CD,STATUS,AUTH_DT,AUTH_ID,MAKER_DT,MAKER_ID,PRIMARY_FLAG)) AS HASHROW, CUST_NO ,CIF_NO,STATUS FROM ( SELECT [CUST_NO] ,[LAST6_CUST_NO] ,[PRIMARY_FLAG] ,[BR_CD] ,[STATUS] ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[AUTH_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as AUTH_DT ,[AUTH_ID] ,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,[MAKER_DT]),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as MAKER_DT ,[MAKER_ID] ,[CIF_NO] ,1 as isActive ,1 as isLatest ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE] ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE] ,[FILE_NAME] ,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm FROM [D360].[STG_TRU_BASELINK] where H = 'D' ) A ), TGT AS ( SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CUST_NO,CIF_NO,BR_CD,STATUS,AUTH_DT,AUTH_ID,MAKER_DT,MAKER_ID,PRIMARY_FLAG)) AS HASHROW, CUST_NO ,CIF_NO,STATUS FROM BUSC.TRU_BASELINK WHERE isLatest = 1 ) INSERT INTO BUSC.TRU_BASELINK_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,CUST_NO,CIF_NO,STATUS,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS) SELECT SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR ,ISNULL(SRC.CUST_NO,TGT.CUST_NO) AS CUST_NO ,ISNULL(SRC.CIF_NO,TGT.CIF_NO) AS CIF_NO ,ISNULL(SRC.STATUS,TGT.STATUS) AS STATUS ,CASE WHEN SRC.CUST_NO IS NULL AND SRC.CIF_NO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive ,CASE WHEN SRC.CUST_NO IS NULL AND SRC.CIF_NO IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest ,CASE WHEN SRC.STATUS != 'A' THEN 'DELETE' WHEN TGT.CUST_NO IS NULL AND TGT.CIF_NO IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS FROM SRC FULL OUTER JOIN TGT ON SRC.CUST_NO = TGT.CUST_NO AND SRC.CIF_NO = TGT.CIF_NO WHERE ( TGT.CUST_NO IS NULL OR TGT.CIF_NO IS NULL ) OR SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW

SELECT 
STG.[CUST_NO]
,[LAST6_CUST_NO]
,[PRIMARY_FLAG]
,[BR_CD]
,STG.[STATUS]
,convert(date,[AUTH_DT]) as AUTH_DT
,[AUTH_ID]
,convert(date,[MAKER_DT]) as MAKER_DT
,[MAKER_ID]
,STG.[CIF_NO]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM truncate table [BUSC].[TRU_BASELINK] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [D360].[STG_TRU_BASELINK] STG ON DELTA.CUST_NO = STG.CUST_NO AND DELTA.CIF_NO = STG.CIF_NO 
  
 where H = 'D' and record_status = 'insert'
